data.mesh:
defaultConfig:
  proxyStatsMatcher:
    inclusionRegexps:
    - .*\.upstream_rq_active$
    - .*\.upstream_rq_pending_active$
    - .*\.upstream_rq_pending_overflow$
    - .*\.upstream_rq_timeout$
    - .*\.upstream_rq_retry$
    - .*\.no_healthy_upstream$
    - .*\.downstream_cx_active$
  discoveryAddress: istiod.istio-system.svc:15012
defaultProviders:
  metrics:
  - prometheus
enablePrometheusMerge: true
rootNamespace: istio-system
trustDomain: cluster.local
